interpretation_and_limits: The device driver supports both required extensions and the current renderer successfully executes its standalone 4x-to-1x depth/stencil resolve path when a test-created VkDevice enables them.
The currently installed app provider is still the v0.10.0 provider and does not expose or enable these extensions; this test does not change that runtime.
The renderer test uses offscreen regression fixtures. It is not a retail language-menu capture or proof of retail image parity.
